records.title: 'Projects Approved under SWAMIH Fund 1.0'
details: a: *3 projects (2 in Maharashtra and 1 in Punjab ) are pending for first disbursement.

records.title: Development of Ramayapatnam and Machilipatnam Ports.
details:
c: As per information furnished by GoAP, the expected scheduled completion date for Phase-I of the Ramayapatna Port project in November 2026 and commissioning is expected by May 2027.
As regards Machilipatnam Port, the expected scheduled completion date for Phase-I of the project is December 2026 and commissioning is expected by June 2027.

records.title: Environment Protection Charges
details: Part (d) & (e); As per annexure-vi it was inter-alia stated that proposal of Rs. 73.067 Crore for road construction/repair & paving works and procurement of MRSMs and ASGs, received from 08 agencies in Delhi-NCR, are under consideration but have kept in abeyance in view of concurrence awaited from Hon'ble NGT.
